name: M3_PPS001MI_ConfirmLine
description: Confirm a single purchase order line by updating supplier‑confirmed delivery, quantity, price, discount, and logistics information. The operation works on one specific purchase order number, line number, and subline number and writes the confirmation back to the existing line. Key values include confirmed delivery date, confirmed quantity in the purchase unit of measure, confirmed purchase price and price quantity, and up to three confirmed discount percentages. Confirmed quantity and price replace ordered values in material and cost calculations. You can also maintain delivery terms, delivery method, harbor or airport, rail station, pickup address, ship‑to warehouse, and optionally mark the line as completed so remaining quantity is not backordered. No data is returned in the response.

inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number identifying the order containing the line to confirm.

inputParameters.name: PNLI
inputParameters.description: Purchase order line number identifying the line to confirm.

inputParameters.name: PNLS
inputParameters.description: Subline suffix identifying the specific purchase order subline to confirm.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number of the company that owns the purchase order.

inputParameters.name: LNCD
inputParameters.description: Language code used for external documents or messages related to this purchase order confirmation.

inputParameters.name: SUNO
inputParameters.description: Supplier number for the vendor providing the goods on this purchase order.

inputParameters.name: YRE1
inputParameters.description: Contact person at the supplier or customer to be referred to for this purchase order.

inputParameters.name: SORN
inputParameters.description: Supplier’s own order number associated with this purchase order.

inputParameters.name: CODT
inputParameters.description: Confirmed delivery date for this purchase order line or subline.

inputParameters.name: CFQA
inputParameters.description: Quantity confirmed for delivery on this subline in the purchase unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: CPPR
inputParameters.description: Confirmed purchase price per unit for this purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: CPUC
inputParameters.description: Confirmed purchase price quantity in the purchase price unit of measure for this line.

inputParameters.name: CFD1
inputParameters.description: First confirmed discount percentage applied to the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: CFD2
inputParameters.description: Second confirmed discount percentage applied to the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: CFD3
inputParameters.description: Third confirmed discount percentage applied to the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: ZDI1
inputParameters.description: Not used; retained for compatibility as a former 'clear discount 1' flag.

inputParameters.name: ZDI2
inputParameters.description: Not used; retained for compatibility as a former 'clear discount 2' flag.

inputParameters.name: ZDI3
inputParameters.description: Not used; retained for compatibility as a former 'clear discount 3' flag.

inputParameters.name: PDDT
inputParameters.description: Deviating confirmed delivery date differing from the standard confirmed delivery date for this line.

inputParameters.name: PUSL
inputParameters.description: Lowest status code among all lines on the purchase order.

inputParameters.name: COLI
inputParameters.description: Not used; retained for compatibility as a former continue-line indicator.

inputParameters.name: OEND
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the purchase order line is flagged as completed so remaining quantity will not be backordered.

inputParameters.name: TIHM
inputParameters.description: Time of the confirmation transaction expressed in hours and minutes.

inputParameters.name: TEDL
inputParameters.description: Delivery terms defining when responsibility for the goods transfers from supplier to buyer.

inputParameters.name: MODL
inputParameters.description: Delivery method indicating how the supplier will deliver the goods for this purchase order.

inputParameters.name: HAFE
inputParameters.description: Identifier of the harbor or airport linked to this purchase order for transport or statistical purposes.

inputParameters.name: RASN
inputParameters.description: Identifier of the rail station associated with the transport for this purchase order.

inputParameters.name: CIAD
inputParameters.description: Confirmed pickup address where the goods will be collected.

inputParameters.name: SADR
inputParameters.description: Supplier’s address reference used to identify the relevant supplier address for this purchase order.

inputParameters.name: STWH
inputParameters.description: Ship-to warehouse where the goods on this purchase order line will be received.

inputParameters.name: CPRD
inputParameters.description: Confirmed manufacturer identifying the company that produced the goods on this purchase order line.
